items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, it reminds me that the last time I saw you play with Harvey was for Johnny Pate.

ctx.x: hear the sound in front of me live, and he's got a great cymbal, he's got a great snare drum sound, gotta great bass drum sound, and he plays the form of the tune. And I like that.
Well, it reminds me that the last time I saw you play with Harvey was for Johnny Pate. I haven't mentioned Johnny in producers or whatevers.
